scope: Bookmark feedback, saved-room empty state, animated native agreements, contribution heatmap, synchronized progress ring and configurable study goals
browser: isolated Chromium with desktop/mobile viewport emulation

checks: Resume action keeps only its play icon, without a right arrow
Bookmark saves immediately
Bookmark icon plays a short pop after saving
Saving adds a small burst without changing card layout
Saved filter displays the bookmarked room
Saved empty state has no result count or reset button
Saved empty state has no border or background
Keyboard Space also saves a room
Reduced motion skips bookmark transforms
Progress arc and counter stay synchronized during animation, not only at the end
Progress ring label settles at its semantic value
Progress arc and count use the same value
주: contribution grid has one cell per date
월: contribution grid has one cell per date
년: contribution grid has one cell per date
Cell hover reveals the date and recorded time
Heatmap selection updates the detail panel
Arrow keys navigate contribution dates
Legend hover highlights matching contribution levels
768px: annual chart scroll stays inside its panel
390px: annual chart scroll stays inside its panel
320px: annual chart scroll stays inside its panel
Terms remain a native required checkbox
Checkbox checkmark draws along its stroke
Space toggles the checkbox without a custom keyboard handler
Native form reset clears both animated checkboxes
Reduced motion removes checkmark animation
Signup cannot continue without privacy agreement
Valid agreements preserve the signup flow
Goal quick selection changes the chosen duration
Goal slider changes in five-minute steps
Study timer uses the chosen goal
New study starts at zero elapsed time
Pause does not consume goal time
Reload restores the chosen goal and paused elapsed time
Reaching a custom goal enters the break phase
Goal completion stores and displays the actual target
Returning from the home banner restores the previous chosen goal
Returning from home also preserves the chosen conversation option
Early finish stores actual minutes separately from the longer goal
No application runtime or console errors

limitations: Other browser engines and physical mobile devices were not exercised.
Authentication, payment, camera analysis and focus measurements remain frontend demo behavior.
artifacts: Development-only screenshots and browser runner in /private/tmp/capsule-refinement-review and /private/tmp/capsule-wireframe-browser/refinement-qa.mjs.
